The activity requests extraction of payroll records, employee compensation costs, and procurement expenses for audit reconciliation. None of the candidates fulfill this requirement:

- The agents (ProductionChangeOrchestrator, SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator, AssetLifecycleChangeOrchestrator, EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning, AssetProvisioningOrchestrator) focus on engineering changes, material provisioning, and production coordination—not financial/payroll data extraction.
- The APIs and dataProducts (MaterialReceiptInboundAPI, ProductChangeImpactAndMaterialAnalytics, EngineeringChangeImpactAndWorkforceReadiness) address material receipts, workforce readiness, and operational impact—not payroll, compensation costs, or financial audit reconciliation.

This activity requires HR/payroll systems and financial accounting systems that are not represented in the candidate set. The topical overlap (engineering changes, materials) does not bridge to the actual financial and compensation data extraction capability needed.
